units.source_text: 于是只见水花四溅，木贼草倒下，绽开的燕子花被撕碎了。

en.t: Then water splashed everywhere, the horsetails fell over, and the blooming irises were torn apart.

units.source_text: 我冒犯偷窃的罪名摘来的花草，竟落得如此狼狈周章的下场。

en.t: The flowers and grasses I had picked, committing the offense of theft, had come to such a miserable, chaotic end.

units.source_text: 我不由得站起身来，却又不知所措，将背脊靠在窗玻璃上。

en.t: I could not help standing up, but then, at a loss, I leaned my back against the window glass.

units.source_text: 我看见柏木一把抓住女人的纤细的手腕，尔后又揪住她的头发，扇了她一记耳光。

en.t: I saw Kashiwagi seize the woman's slender wrist, then grab her hair and slap her across the face.

units.source_text: 柏木这一连串粗野的动作，实际上同方才插花时用剪子把叶和茎剪掉的平静的残忍劲是毫无二致的，

en.t: This series of rough actions by Kashiwagi was in fact no different from the calm cruelty with which, just before, he had cut away leaves and stems with the scissors while arranging the flowers,

units.source_text: 仿佛是方才的那股子劲儿的延长。

en.t: as though it were an extension of that very same force from moments earlier.
